checkpoints.title: CLI: aayu measure <goal> with the metric aayu:founder_minutes_per_pr reads the actions segments on the ledger (human-identity records only) and the pull requests merged into dev in the window, and writes the Result naming the population, the window, both keys, and the value. A window with no merged pull request, no ledger, an unreadable pull request list, another aayu: metric, or a segment line that does not decode stops measure and writes no Result. The measure itself is internal/measure.Founder, a pure function of the records, the merged count, the window, and [outcomes]
contracts: measure.Founder(records []actions.Record, merged int, w Window, o config.Outcomes, dev string) (value float64, detail string, err error); err wraps ErrNoData when merged is 0
